description: Keyword search across the AcuiQ reference wiki – the call to make when you have a topic or a question ("moxibustion", "what does EX-HN mean", "acupuncture in pregnancy") and no page path. Matches titles and page prose. A whole question works: when no literal match exists it falls back to English full-text matching, which stems words and drops stopwords. It is NOT semantic, so a page that says "moxa" is not found by "heat therapy". Ranked titles starting with the term, then titles containing it, then literal prose hits, then full-text hits by relevance. Each row carries a `snippet` windowed on the match, the `path` get_wiki_page takes, and the `markdown` URL holding the whole page. Use get_wiki_page instead when you already have a path, or to see every page by section. Defaults: page 1, pageSize 10 (max 50); keep paging while `hasMore` is true. The same rows as GET /api/wiki?q=.

query.description: A keyword, phrase or question (e.g. "cupping", "is acupuncture safe in pregnancy")
